parsed.explanation: The dossier has no trans-specific criminal offence, no documented facility exclusion, border rule or custody placement rule, and no documented trans-specific violence or targeting. Pride marches and a drop-in centre show tolerated public presence. Against that, the traveller-facing exposures are real but partial: the 2024 act forbids recognising foreign same-sex marriages, and officials ignore the 2023 ruling, so a trans visitor whose relationship reads as same-sex has no reliable spousal protection. A 1980 immoral-practices act can reach public affection between men. Organised political hostility exists, and the record shows no visitor-facing discrimination survey, detention placement rule or emergency-care evidence. Sexuality-law and resident-facing items are discounted. Extrapolating from the thin trans-specific record, I place this in the reduced-to-elevated band, with a dead-letter sodomy statute as a secondary signal only.
